sources.title: GitHub - deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-MoE: DeepSeekMoE: Towards Ultimate Expert ...
sources.snippet: DeepSeekMoE 16B is a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 16.4B parameters. It employs an innovative MoE architecture, which involves two principal strategies: fine-grained expert segmentation and shared experts isolation. It is trained from scratch on 2T English and Chinese tokens, and exhibits comparable performance with DeekSeek 7B and LLaMA2 7B, with only about 40% of computations ...

sources.title: Deepseek Moe 16b Q4 K M Cpu Offload Gguf - model.aibase.com
sources.snippet: This is the Q4_K_M quantized version of the DeepSeek-MoE-16B model from DeepSeek Company. It enables the MoE (Mixture of Experts) CPU offload function through the Rust binding of llama.cpp, significantly reducing video memory usage.
